statement: On 44 fresh prime-order Weierstrass curves (group orders about 2^22 to 2^32), T = 1024/4096/16384, 22 paired configurations per cell, counted F_p operations (I = 3/10/30 M, S = M) with hash/solver ops at 0/0.1/1 GAE: the k = 4 term multi-target index calculus ic5 costs 0.47-0.99x per target of ic4 (cheaper in all 36 cell x I/M section-5a decisions) and 1.11-1.49x a paired BSGS (dearer in all 36); against the cheapest of 12 runs of this harness's anchored fixed-database rho family it is 0.85-0.98x, but against the same family with Kuhn-Struik retention (validator arm rho2xks) it is 1.07-1.34x at h = 0 and 1.05-1.18x at h = 0.1, so no ranking against rho is established.
